## Modules

- DSL &amp; Core
  - [DurableObject](https://durable-object.hexdocs.pm/DurableObject.md): Durable Objects for Elixir.
  - [DurableObject.Dsl](https://durable-object.hexdocs.pm/DurableObject.Dsl.md): Spark DSL for defining Durable Objects.
  - [DurableObject.Dsl.Extension](https://durable-object.hexdocs.pm/DurableObject.Dsl.Extension.md): Spark DSL extension defining the structure for Durable Objects.

- Storage
  - [DurableObject.Storage](https://durable-object.hexdocs.pm/DurableObject.Storage.md): Handles persistence of Durable Object state to the database.
  - [DurableObject.Storage.Schemas.Alarm](https://durable-object.hexdocs.pm/DurableObject.Storage.Schemas.Alarm.md): Ecto schema for durable_object_alarms table.
  - [DurableObject.Storage.Schemas.Object](https://durable-object.hexdocs.pm/DurableObject.Storage.Schemas.Object.md): Ecto schema for durable_objects table.

- Scheduling
  - [DurableObject.Scheduler](https://durable-object.hexdocs.pm/DurableObject.Scheduler.md): Behaviour for alarm scheduling backends.
  - [DurableObject.Scheduler.Oban](https://durable-object.hexdocs.pm/DurableObject.Scheduler.Oban.md): Oban-based alarm scheduler.
  - [DurableObject.Scheduler.Polling](https://durable-object.hexdocs.pm/DurableObject.Scheduler.Polling.md): Polling-based scheduler that persists alarms to the database
and periodically checks for overdue alarms.

- Internals
  - [DurableObject.Behaviour](https://durable-object.hexdocs.pm/DurableObject.Behaviour.md): Behaviour for Durable Object alarm handling.
  - [DurableObject.Cluster](https://durable-object.hexdocs.pm/DurableObject.Cluster.md): Facade module for registry and supervisor operations.
  - [DurableObject.Migration](https://durable-object.hexdocs.pm/DurableObject.Migration.md): Versioned migrations for DurableObject tables.
  - [DurableObject.ObjectSupervisor](https://durable-object.hexdocs.pm/DurableObject.ObjectSupervisor.md): Interface for Durable Object supervision.
  - [DurableObject.Server](https://durable-object.hexdocs.pm/DurableObject.Server.md): GenServer that backs each Durable Object instance.

  - [DurableObject.Singleton](https://durable-object.hexdocs.pm/DurableObject.Singleton.md): Cluster singleton utility for ensuring only one instance of a process
runs across the cluster when using Horde mode.
  - [DurableObject.Telemetry](https://durable-object.hexdocs.pm/DurableObject.Telemetry.md): Telemetry instrumentation for DurableObject.
  - [DurableObject.Testing](https://durable-object.hexdocs.pm/DurableObject.Testing.md): Test helpers for DurableObject applications.
  - [DurableObject.Cluster.Backend](https://durable-object.hexdocs.pm/DurableObject.Cluster.Backend.md): Behaviour definition for cluster backend implementations.
  - [DurableObject.Cluster.Horde](https://durable-object.hexdocs.pm/DurableObject.Cluster.Horde.md): Horde-mode cluster backend using Horde.Registry and Horde.DynamicSupervisor.
  - [DurableObject.Cluster.Local](https://durable-object.hexdocs.pm/DurableObject.Cluster.Local.md): Local-mode cluster backend using Elixir's built-in Registry and DynamicSupervisor.
  - [DurableObject.Dsl.Field](https://durable-object.hexdocs.pm/DurableObject.Dsl.Field.md): Struct representing a state field in a Durable Object.
  - [DurableObject.Dsl.Handler](https://durable-object.hexdocs.pm/DurableObject.Dsl.Handler.md): Struct representing a handler (RPC method) in a Durable Object.
  - [DurableObject.Dsl.Transformers.BuildIntrospection](https://durable-object.hexdocs.pm/DurableObject.Dsl.Transformers.BuildIntrospection.md): Transformer that generates `__durable_object__/1` introspection functions
and a nested `State` struct.
  - [DurableObject.Dsl.Transformers.GenerateClient](https://durable-object.hexdocs.pm/DurableObject.Dsl.Transformers.GenerateClient.md): Transformer that generates client API functions for each declared handler.
  - [DurableObject.Dsl.Verifiers.ValidateFields](https://durable-object.hexdocs.pm/DurableObject.Dsl.Verifiers.ValidateFields.md): Verifier that validates field names in the state block.
  - [DurableObject.Dsl.Verifiers.ValidateHandlers](https://durable-object.hexdocs.pm/DurableObject.Dsl.Verifiers.ValidateHandlers.md): Verifier that validates handler callbacks are properly defined.

## Mix Tasks

- Internals
  - [mix durable_object.gen.migration](https://durable-object.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.DurableObject.Gen.Migration.md): Generates an upgrade migration for DurableObject.
  - [mix durable_object.gen.object](https://durable-object.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.DurableObject.Gen.Object.md): Generates a new Durable Object module.
  - [mix durable_object.install](https://durable-object.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.DurableObject.Install.md): Installs DurableObject into your project.
